quality_gate: not required; explicit separate descriptive resource study of all existing edits
cache_policy: Fresh dedicated Chrome profile and empty IndexedDB weights per session; same local hash-verified no-store fetch. OS filesystem caches are not cleared and may be warmed by verification.
analysis: Session is the replication unit: two observations per artifact, individual values and mean/min/max; descriptive deltas against current pristine. No request-level pseudoreplication, precise equality claim or quality improvement inferred. Missing or incomplete paired sessions yield unavailable means/deltas.
